overview: EventFlash is an efficient multimodal large language model for event-based vision, leveraging spatiotemporal token sparsification and curriculum learning to accelerate inference and enable long-range understanding.

modules.name: Event Stream Simulation and Filtering
modules.description: Convert video datasets to event streams using a simulator, and automatically filter videos based on textual annotations to ensure high-quality simulated events.

modules.name: Instruction Set Generation
modules.description: Generate and refine textual instructions for seven event understanding tasks, using language models for auto-generation and refinement, followed by manual quality assurance.

modules.name: EventMind Dataset Class
modules.description: Custom PyTorch dataset for loading event bins and corresponding instructions, supporting variable-length event sequences and multi-task data handling.

modules.name: Curriculum DataLoader
modules.description: Batch sampler that organizes data according to the three curriculum learning stages, providing appropriate short, medium, or long event sequences per stage.

modules.name: Event Encoder Integration
modules.description: Load and adapt a pre-trained vision transformer model to extract features from event bins, handling the unique input format of event data.

modules.name: Adaptive Temporal Window Aggregation Module
modules.description: Implement a density-aware temporal token merging strategy that adaptively compresses temporal bins while preserving key motion dynamics and temporal cues.

modules.name: Sparse Density-Guided Attention Module
modules.description: Implement a spatial token efficiency module that uses event density information to guide attention, selecting informative regions and suppressing sparse or empty areas.

modules.name: Event-Language Projector
modules.description: Implement a multi-layer perceptron to project event tokens into the language model's embedding space, enabling cross-modal alignment.

modules.name: EventFlash Model Assembly
modules.description: Combine the event encoder, temporal aggregation, spatial attention, projector, and language model into an end-to-end multimodal model for event stream understanding.

modules.name: Training Loop with Curriculum Strategy
modules.description: Manage the three-stage training process, including parameter freezing/unfreezing, optimization, learning rate scheduling, and gradient accumulation.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Implementation
modules.description: Implement evaluation metrics for global captioning, fine-grained QA, human action QA, and multiple-choice QA, using both language model judging and exact matching.

modules.name: Efficiency Measurement
modules.description: Measure and report model throughput (tokens per second) and maximum event bin capacity, comparing with baseline and other methods.

modules.name: Ablation Study Runner
modules.description: Automated framework to run ablation experiments, varying model components, temporal aggregation intervals, and density attenuation factors.

modules.name: Benchmark Comparison Runner
modules.description: Automated framework to run comparison experiments against state-of-the-art video-based and event-based multimodal models on standard benchmarks.

modules.name: Downstream Task Fine-tuning
modules.description: Adapt the model for action recognition on a benchmark dataset, fine-tuning with an open-ended QA setting and evaluating top-1 accuracy.

modules.name: Visualization and Result Generation
modules.description: Generate visual explanations such as attention maps, qualitative examples for high-speed and low-light scenarios, and produce LaTeX tables and charts for results.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management
modules.description: Parse experiment configurations, log hyperparameters, and integrate with experiment tracking tools for monitoring and reproducibility.
